purpose: Authoritative implementation inventory for provisioning a configured project's project-local Hepha workflow contract.

managedAssetGroups.migrationNote: The source remains .workflows until the legacy-path migration moves the canonical bundle to .hepha/workflows.

projectOwnedAssets.setupRule: Create from explicit project defaults when absent; validate and preserve when present; never silently overwrite.

Preserve when present. When REVIEW_CONTRACT_V1 requires a catalog, setup must create a valid project-appropriate catalog from an explicit template or report setup incomplete. Never borrow Hepha's own project catalog implicitly.

requiredCompatibilityChecks: Every listed managed file exists at the project destination.
Every managed file has a recorded Hepha release and SHA-256 checksum.
Every JSON schema parses and all local $ref targets resolve inside the project .hepha/schemas directory.
The review schemas are semantically compatible with the current runtime review types and validators; byte equality with a stale source schema is not readiness evidence.
The review-manifest schema and runtime agree on minimum findings, optional OBSERVATION authority, compatibility-decision fields, disposition field requirements, and forbidden fields.
All YAML assets parse with duplicate-key rejection and all workflow references resolve to copied project-local commands, agents, contexts, schemas, skills, and safety assets.
Every launch-bearing workflow node declares exactly one registered top-level agent_action and matching command metadata; deterministic action, gate, and grouping nodes remain route-neutral.

Commands, agents, project skills, package lifecycle skills, configured skill-path overrides, and copied workflow layouts pass validatePortableModelAuthorityInventory with no model/provider/model-policy/routing/effort/fallback/authentication fields or host-switch directives.

Direct lifecycle skills declare direct_host authority for the current Pi, Codex, or Claude Code session and never query Hepha routing, switch model, hand off automatically, or fabricate an orchestrated receipt.
REVIEW_CONTRACT_V1 preflight executes a representative no-finding-scope APPROVED observation manifest and, when configured, an active-rule manifest against the project catalog.
No workflow resolves a required contract from the Hepha source repository, another configured project, or ~/.pi.

knownFailurePrevented.cause: The project had copied schema files, but schema/runtime compatibility was not proven and the project had no .hepha/architecture-rules.yaml while the active V1 validation path attempted to load one unconditionally.
knownFailurePrevented.lesson: Setup readiness must validate the complete executable contract, not only directory presence, JSON parsing, or equality with the current Hepha source files.
